text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Swan Stakes
had concluded.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's something I'd like to consult
you about, do you have a moment~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So, about Biko-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Upon asking for more details,
it seemed she hadn't been quite herself lately."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
She's always smiling, but
every once in a while, she looks really down in the dumps.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, you were really down during the Sprinters Stakes, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so amazed by Bono's running.
Their eyes were sparkling...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...And yet, I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I feel like they've been losing their energy
little by little since then~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's about the race, and well,
I was wondering what I should do~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having some fun might lighten the mood,
and maybe we can hear what they have to say along the way."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see...!
That's a great idea, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so――

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Awesome! It's full of mandarins!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmhmm, it's totally full of sweet smells~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was out picking mandarins!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps going all out for the season, they're handing out balloons to departing children, and a wide variety of souvenirs are lined up. It seems to be a thriving success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by a peaceful atmosphere, we each picked mandarin oranges to our heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bonobono, look!
I picked a whole bunch that smell so nice~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, nice! Smaller mandarins are
packed with sweetness, making them so buono~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really!?Bono, you know everything! That's so cool!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's tiny, but it packs so much flavor, it's super cool!
It reminded me of Biko-chan, so I remembered it right away~."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah... I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm not looking very cool at all!
I can't even win when it matters most!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"My positioning was terrible,
and once I got boxed in, I couldn't move forward at all!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Really, not at all... Like this,
there's no way I can give courage to everyone—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Biko-chan...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, whoa! Sorry! Forget I said that!"

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along with a loud, sudden cry,
a red balloon flew high into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we give up on this one?
I'll go get another for you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
No way! It's the last time I get to play with Mio-chan,
so I wanna do the same thing as Mio-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...I see. It's a special balloon to you, huh.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry!
I'll definitely win it back for you!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's get going too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I caught up, Biko Pegasus had climbed high up a tree and was reaching for a balloon caught in the branches.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hngnnnnn~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, with her small frame,
it seemed she was just a tiny bit out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: That's way too dangerous. Let me take over.
That's way too dangerous, I'll take over.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mm, no. Biko-chan will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Everything will be fine, absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
J-Just a little bit more...!
Just a little further!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Don't push yourself too hard, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks! I'm good!
Just wait a little bit longer for me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, here we go.
—Phew, haah... Alright!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaning far out while holding onto a branch,
Biko Pegasus successfully grabbed the balloon! But—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The moment he leaned out, the branch he was holding snapped,
and Biko Pegasus plunged headfirst—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Toh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono dashed forward
and caught them securely without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —S-Sorry! Bono! Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No prob, no prob! More importantly,
Biko-chan really is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You really got your balloon back, didn't you~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono gazed fondly at Biko Pegasus,
who was tightly clutching his balloon.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew. A lot happened, but that was fun!
We picked plenty of mandarins, too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What should I make when I get home? Marmalade
sounds nice, but regular jam could be good too~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What would you like, Biko-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, huh, ah.
Uh, sorry! I wasn't listening!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's eat a mandarin orange!
I'm sure this is gonna be super buono~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Hishi Akebono split a small mandarin orange
in half and placed it in Biko Pegasus's hand.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks!
*munch*... It's true! It's sweet and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Biko-chan. I really do think
you're super cool."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I'm pretty big myself,
so I can only imagine what it's like
for Biko-chan, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: When you're small, jockeying for position is tough, and getting boxed in makes it look really hard to break out... things like that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even with an amazing final kick, if bad luck during the race
delays your move and you fall short at the end,
it'd be so frustrating... thoughts like that, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, Biko-chan,
you're always looking forward and doing your best, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's hard, even if it's painful, I won't give up.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I think we were able to get the balloon back too~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bono...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's things like that that make you a hero to me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure it'll become that way for everyone else someday too~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Hishi Akebono's relaxed words,
Biko Pegasus froze in place for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Biko-chan?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah... T-Thanks, Bono.
Yeah... You're right..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! I haven't really been doing
as well in races as I thought I would.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Earlier too, Bono ended up having to help me out, so I was really useless...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Just a little, just a teeny bit, I ended up thinking that maybe I'm not worthy of being a hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: But I'm alright now!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus won't give up! Even if she falls
to her knees once, she'll stand up again and again!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
That's Biko-chan for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Biko Pegasus regain his energy,
Hishi Akebono also broke into a big smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I suddenly recall her past words.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's a race between me and Biko-chan,
so you're bound to leave totally full and satisfied!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's deep trust in Biko Pegasus
remains steadfast as ever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a day where I truly felt the strong bond between the two of them.
